members.name: Hints
members.text:
2,10,11,16,18,22
Click on the squares you want to plow. Each square
represents 20 acres. Decide how many workers to hire
by clicking on the arrows in the Workers box. To start 
plowing, click on OK. To leave the fields without plowing,
click on Cancel. Tip: In the spring try to finish plowing
your fields by the end of May, before the heavy summer
rains start and the ground becomes too muddy for plowing.
In the fall, try to finish plowing before the first frost,
which comes in early October.
Once you have finished plowing your field, decide which 
seeds to plant. Make sure that you have bought enough 
seeds before you start planting. To plant, drag the seeds
 from the Seeds in Storage to the square you want to plant.
To start planting, click on OK. 
To leave the field without planting, click on Cancel.

Decide how many workers to hire by clicking on the arrows
 in the Workers box. Tip: Try to finish harvesting winter wheat 
in time to prepare your fields for planting summer crops. 
Try to finish harvesting summer crops in time to prepare
 your fields for planting winter wheat.

members.name: NoPlow1
members.text: There are enough things to do here. You don't have to plow the fields twice and make extra work for yourself.

members.name: NoPlow2
members.text: You planted some crops that you haven't harvested yet. If you plow now, you will destroy all your hard work.

members.name: NoPlow3
members.text: The land is frozen. If you plow now, you could break your plow. It's better to wait until spring.

members.name: Noplow4
members.text: The land is very muddy from all the rain. The plow will sink in the mud. It's better to wait until fall.

members.name: NoPlow5
members.text: Hello, neighbor. I'm glad to see you. It's not time to plant yet. First, you should harvest the last crop that you planted.

members.name: NoPlow6
members.text: I'm waiting for you to sell me your crops. I'll give you a good price.

members.name: FDBK7
members.text: Great. Now that you finished plowing,                 you can start planting.

members.name: StopPlow1
members.text: The summer rains started before you finished  plowing. You have to stop plowing now. Your fields are all muddy.

members.name: StopPlow2
members.text: The ground froze before you finished plowing. You have to stop plowing now. It's starting to snow.

members.name: StopPlow3
members.text:
Your plow broke. The land is very hard in this area. What are you going to do?

      1.  Buy a new steel right away for $50.

      2.  Fix the old plow for free, 
           which takes a few days.

members.name: StopPlow4
members.text: One of your horses is sick. Now you can use only one horse, so your plowing will take twice as long.

members.name: NoMoney
members.text:
I'm sorry. You don't have enough cash
                    to buy a new plow.

members.name: NoPlant1
members.text: You don't have any seeds. Drop by the store to order some. You can look at our catalog which shows the seeds you can buy and the plants you can grow from them.

members.name: NoPlant2
members.text: Soon the hot summer sun will beat down on your fields and dry out your seeds. If I were you, I would plow my land before I plant those seeds.

members.name: NoPlant3
members.text: If you don't plow your land soon, the winds will scatter most of your seeds. Those seeds will grow, but not necessarily on your land.

members.name: NoPlant4
members.text: Hello, neighbor. I'm glad to see you. It's not time to plant yet. First, you should harvest the last crop that you planted.

members.name: NoPlant5
members.text: I think the seed catalog suggested a different season for planting those seeds. If I were you, I would check the catalog.

members.name: NoHarv1
members.text: Have patience, my friend. Give your plants enough time to grow before you harvest them.

members.name: NoHarv2
members.text: My friend, you have to plant before you can harvest.You can't get something from nothing.

members.name: NoHarv3
members.text: Hello there, neighbor. I see that you still have a bit to learn about farming. You can't harvest your fields before you've even plowed them and planted some seeds.

members.name: Tractor
members.text: There aren't enough tractors for all of us. Make sure that you have a tractor for each worker you hire.

members.name: OneWor
members.text: I'm sorry. You don't have enough money to pay me. I can't work for you if you can't pay me.

members.name: ManyWor
members.text: I'm sorry. You don't have enough money to pay us. We can't work for you if you can't pay us.

members.name: StopHarv1
members.text: The summer rains started early this year. They destroyed the rest of your crops. There's no point in harvesting them now.

members.name: StopHarv2
members.text: Winter came early this year. The first frost killed the rest of your crops. There's no point in harvesting them now.

members.name: NoBuild
members.text: You need more money to do this.

members.name: NoSell
members.text: You have nothing to sell.

members.name: GoBank
members.text: Go to the bank to collect your money.

members.name: FDB18
members.text: You were lucky. The summer rains started late this year. Your horse recovered and you finished plowing before the rain started.

members.name: FDBK19
members.text: You were lucky this time. The horses recovered and you finished plowing before the snow started.
